UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Student focus profile, streaks, daily goal, gem wallet, unlocked ambient sounds, cosmetic upgrades, and claimed path milestones.

gems.description: Current spendable Gem balance earned from focus sessions and tasks

lastFocusDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of last completed focus session

unlockedSounds.description: Ambient sound preset IDs unlocked with gems

unlockedCosmetics.description: Cosmetic theme and mascot badge IDs unlocked with gems

claimedMilestones.description: Focus Path milestone IDs whose gem chests have been claimed

equippedBadge.description: Currently equipped mascot badge/ring style ID

role.description: Firestore RBAC role ('user' default; 'admin' grants access to Admin Dashboard and app-wide settings)

FocusSession.title: FocusSession
FocusSession.description: Completed focus session with duration, subject, ambient sound, XP, and gems earned.

ambientSound.description: Ambient sound preset used during session

dateKey.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD date string for grouping

PomodoroTask.title: PomodoroTask
PomodoroTask.description: Student study task linked to focus sessions with completion state and sprint counter.

PublicStudyProfile.title: PublicStudyProfile
PublicStudyProfile.description: Consensual, PII-free study-only presence and daily study statistics shared with added study friends in real time.

handle.description: Unique lowercase study handle (3..30 chars, alphanumeric + underscore)

lastFocusDate.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD date of last completed focus session

StudyHandleLookup.title: StudyHandleLookup
StudyHandleLookup.description: Direct O(1) lookup document mapping a unique lowercase @handle to a userId for adding study friends without listing collections.

handle.description: Unique lowercase study handle matching document ID

FriendLink.title: FriendLink
FriendLink.description: Owner-scoped reference to an added study friend whose PublicStudyProfile is observed in real time.

friendUid.description: Added friend's Firebase UID matching document ID

BlockedUser.title: BlockedUser
BlockedUser.description: Owner-scoped private record of a blocked scholar hidden from friends, pending invites, and leaderboard views.

blockedUid.description: Blocked user's Firebase UID matching document ID

StudyChallenge.title: StudyChallenge
StudyChallenge.description: Shared group focus challenge created with friends where all participants' focus minutes aggregate toward a collective goal.

invitedUids.description: UIDs of invited friends awaiting acceptance (0..20)

ChallengeParticipant.title: ChallengeParticipant
ChallengeParticipant.description: Individual participant's aggregated study minutes and session count inside a Study Challenge.

contributedMinutes.description: Minutes contributed toward the shared challenge goal

ChallengeCode.title: ChallengeCode
ChallengeCode.description: Direct O(1) lookup mapping a 6-character challenge invite code to a StudyChallenge ID.

StreakReminderSettings.title: StreakReminderSettings
StreakReminderSettings.description: Owner-scoped Firebase Cloud Messaging device token, subscribed topic, daily streak alert time, timezone, and latest focus date for automated daily streak push notifications.

enabled.description: Whether daily streak push notifications are enabled

fcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging device registration token

lastFocusDate.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD date of last started or completed focus session

StudyChat.title: StudyChat
StudyChat.description: Private 1-to-1 study direct message thread between two Study Circle scholars keyed deterministically by sorted participant UIDs.

participantUids.description: Exactly two distinct participant Firebase UIDs

lastMessageText.description: Preview of the latest message (max 500 chars)

lastSenderUid.description: Firebase UID of the latest message sender

StudyChatMessage.title: StudyChatMessage
StudyChatMessage.description: Immutable direct message sent inside a 1-to-1 Study Circle chat thread.

participantUids.description: Denormalized pair of participant Firebase UIDs for rule-aligned queries

AppLiveConfig.title: AppLiveConfig
AppLiveConfig.description: Admin-managed live remote configuration streamed silently in the background to all signed-in clients with zero loading spinners.

liveTagline.description: Live subtitle shown in Focus Hub header (0..100 chars)

announcementTitle.description: Live update or announcement banner title (0..80 chars)

announcementBody.description: Live update or announcement banner body (0..240 chars)

announcementActive.description: Whether the live announcement banner is visible

updateNoticeLabel.description: Compact live release channel or patch label (0..60 chars)

defaultFocusMinutes.description: Recommended default sprint duration in minutes (5..120)

gemMultiplierPercent.description: Focus gem reward multiplier in percent (100..300)

socialEnabled.description: Live toggle for Social Circle tab visibility

launcherEnabled.description: Live toggle for Study Launcher mode

ambientDrawerEnabled.description: Live toggle for Ambient Sound selection drawer

maintenanceBannerEnabled.description: Shows a calm non-blocking maintenance status badge

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest live push

AdminNotice.title: AdminNotice
AdminNotice.description: Official Admin broadcast or direct non-PII message sent to all scholars or a specific public study handle.

audienceUids.description: Either ['ALL'] for all scholars or [targetUid] for a direct notice

targetLabel.description: Public audience label such as 'All Scholars' or '@handle' (1..60 chars)

AccountModeration.title: AccountModeration
AccountModeration.description: Zero-PII account removal status written by verified Admin when removing a public study account.

userId.description: Target Firebase UID matching document ID

reason.description: Brief moderation reason shown to the affected user (1..160 chars)

/users/{userId}.description: Student focus profile, gem wallet, unlocked sounds/cosmetics, and streaks

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Completed focus sessions with gem and XP rewards

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Study tasks associated with Pomodoro sessions

/users/{userId}/friends/{friendUid}.description: Owner's added study friends observed on the Social Dashboard

/users/{userId}/blockedUsers/{blockedUid.description: Owner's private blocked scholars list enforced client- and rule-side

/users/{userId}/notificationSettings/{se.description: Owner's private FCM registration token and daily study streak push notification schedule

/studyProfiles/{userId}.description: Consensual, PII-free live study statistics readable by signed-in study friends via direct document get and bounded top-50 streak leaderboard queries

/studyHandles/{handle}.description: Direct O(1) handle-to-UID resolution directory for adding friends by @handle

/studyChallenges/{challengeId}.description: Shared group Study Challenges with invited friends and member lists

/studyChallenges/{challengeId}/participa.description: Live per-participant focus contributions aggregated into shared challenge progress

/challengeCodes/{code}.description: Direct O(1) invite code lookup directory for joining Study Challenges

/studyChats/{chatId}.description: Private 1-to-1 study direct chat metadata between two Study Circle scholars

/studyChats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId.description: Real-time 1-to-1 messages exchanged between Study Circle friends

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Live background remote app configuration pushed by the verified Admin and streamed silently to clients

/adminNotices/{noticeId}.description: Official Admin broadcasts and direct study notices delivered silently in real time

/accountModeration/{userId}.description: Zero-PII account removal records managed exclusively by the verified Admin
